snippet.title: Vapor World: Over The Mind - Official Trailer | ID@Xbox April 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Get a fresh look at gameplay and the setting of Vapor World: Over The Mind in this latest trailer for the upcoming narrative-driven Souls-like platformer game. Vapor World: Over The Mind will be available on Xbox Series X/S, Xbox on PC, Xbox Cloud, and Xbox Game Pass. It is also coming to Steam, Nintendo Switch, and PlayStation 5 (PS5). A demo will be available in June 2026.


Lost in darkness, a boy drawn into a twisted dream, no way out. Vapor World is a narrative-driven Souls-like platformer focused on deflection combat set in the atmospheric world of dream. Descend within a shattered mind seeking lost memories. Face a dark, beautiful world born of anguish and regret.
